name: hunty-contract
description: Rate limiter for NFT minting per address

scripts.build:testnet: node init && node scripts/with-env.mjs testnet tsc
scripts.build:staging: node init && node scripts/with-env.mjs staging tsc
scripts.build:mainnet: node init && node scripts/with-env.mjs mainnet tsc
scripts.start:testnet: node init && node scripts/with-env.mjs testnet node dist/index.js
scripts.start:staging: node init && node scripts/with-env.mjs staging node dist/index.js
scripts.start:mainnet: node init && node scripts/with-env.mjs mainnet node dist/index.js
scripts.dev:testnet: node init && node scripts/with-env.mjs testnet tsx watch src/index.ts
scripts.dev:staging: node init && node scripts/with-env.mjs staging tsx watch src/index.ts
